_comment: Functional-team verified SAP standard values. Keyed by SAP ID (string). These always override Claude-generated values.

102641.standardValue:
SAP Standard Work Item Types (pre-delivered):
• MLST – Milestone
• TASK – Task
• PHASE – Phase

SAP Standard Work Item Groups (pre-delivered):
• ADMIN – Administration
• DELIV – Delivery
• MGMT – Management
• PROC – Procurement

Customer-specific groups can be added via SSCUI 102641 (Manage Your Solution) in the Fiori launchpad.
102641.watchOut: Customer-specific work item types and groups must be configured before project templates are built. Changes after go-live require re-assignment of existing work packages.
